cond_0001.intro:
As part of a diverse and hardworking team of specialists, you will be responsible for development and modification of [Product name masked] NC programs for mill, lathes and multi axis machines for various spaceflight systems. You will share in the team's impact on all aspects of producing accurate programs and set-up sheets enabling first article success on tight tolerance high value parts for various spaceflight systems.
You will share in the team's impact on all aspects of the history of space exploration and will require your dedicated commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight.
We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Create NC programs for CNC Mills/Lathes/Multi axis mills and Multi axis lathes/VTLs to ensure engineering requirements are met
Development of machining strategy to take design data and produce machined hardware
Develop and manage set-up sheets
Collaborate with engineers, manufacturing engineers and machinists
Design custom tools and fixtures as needed
Provide DFMA feedback
Process improvement; both machining actual inputs and administrative process changes
Conduct product acceptance within the guidance of the company policy
Maintain configuration control on files and job records
Safely work within an industrial environment
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of 6 years of experience in NC programming
Excellent blueprint reading skills including GD&T per ASME Y14.5M-1994 standard
Tools fixture design
Set-up sheet creation and management
Cutter selection and cutter design if needed
Feed and speeds calculations
Stainless steel and aluminum experience
DFMA
Excellent communication
Fluent in use of precision hand tools and familiar with use of personal computers
Individual must be self-motivating to prioritize work to meet project completion dates
Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of inclusion
Must be a U.S. Citizen or national, U.S. Permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. As a refugee or granted asylum

Unigraphics NX experience

Setup and operate CNC machines

cond_0120.intro:
At [Company name masked], we are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
As part of a diverse and hardworking team of specialists, you will be responsible for development and modification of [Product name masked] NC programs for mill, lathes and multi axis machines for various spaceflight systems. You will share in the team's impact on all aspects of producing accurate programs and set-up sheets enabling first article success on tight tolerance high value parts for various spaceflight systems.
You will share in the team's impact on all aspects of the history of space exploration and will require your dedicated commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight.
We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!
cond_0120.responsibilities:
Create NC programs for CNC Mills/Lathes/Multi axis mills and Multi axis lathes/VTLs to ensure engineering requirements are met
Development of machining strategy to take design data and produce machined hardware
Develop and manage set-up sheets
Collaborate with engineers, manufacturing engineers and machinists
Design custom tools and fixtures as needed
Provide DFMA feedback
Process improvement; both machining actual inputs and administrative process changes
Conduct product acceptance within the guidance of the company policy
Maintain configuration control on files and job records
Safely work within an industrial environment
cond_0120.requirements:
Around 6 years of experience in NC programming, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience with tools and fixture design
Familiarity with set-up sheet creation and management
Experience with cutter selection and cutter design if needed
Background in feed and speeds calculations
Experience working with stainless steel and aluminum
Familiarity with DFMA
Ability to communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders
Comfort using precision hand tools and personal computers
Able to prioritize work and manage project timelines with reasonable independence
Willingness to build positive, professional relationships and contribute to a culture of inclusion
Must be a U.S. Citizen or national, U.S. Permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. As a refugee or granted asylum
Experience with MasterCam X7 or higher is a plus
Exposure to Unigraphics NX is helpful
Experience with nickel based alloys, copper, or titanium is a plus
Familiarity with Vericut or other program verification software is beneficial
Machinist experience is a plus
Experience setting up and operating CNC machines is a plus
cond_0120.encouragement_text:
Blueprint reading skills including GD&T per ASME Y14.5M-1994 standard — candidates with working knowledge of these standards are encouraged to apply
